posts.title: My Guacamole Recipe
posts.description: Many in my personal circle have asked for it, so here’s my guacamole recipe. posts.title: Finding the Longest Cold-Snap
posts.description: Here’s a simple programming question: Given a time-series of temperature measurements, what is the longest continuous sequence of days during which the temperature was below freezing? Pretty straightforward, right? It’s the type of question you might expect to see during a technical interview or a first-year lesson on how arrays work.
